notes.content:

Hello everyone! 

I am happy to introduce you the launch trailer for my new game Me in the Office.  The game has been published today after a long and difficult time in development. notes.title: UPDATE v1.05
notes.content:
It has been a while in the making, but based on community feedback, please welcome the all new "Horror Mode". Full details can be found below:

[list]
    [*] Horror mode - creepy old castle, giant flying ghost and loads of jump scares
    [*] Improved level unlocking process - players need only to complete story mode to unlock the next level
    [*] Additional settings such as v-sync and volume control
    [*] Loads of gameplay improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

Enjoy!

[img]https://s26.postimg.org/tgvup4amx/HORROR_MODE_SCREENSHOT.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Horror mode is coming!
notes.content:
Hi, guys.

It has been quite sometime since I was last in touch, but now I am back! 

Next week I will be releasing the "Horror Mode". This delivers a brand new gameplay, plus a whole range of great new updates and improvements. I will be announcing the details of the update in full when it goes live next week, but in the meantime check out the new gameplay video which will give you some clue as to the new Horror mode.

Video preview here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zB-FP8_ipss

notes.title: UPDATE v 1.02
notes.content:
New update is ready with such improvements: 

[list]
    [*]Better scene loading system, which avoids lags and screen tearing during gameplay.
    [*]Shaders optimisation. 
    [*]Improved hints system.
    [*]Sound and music improvements.
    [*]Invert mouse option has been added. 
[/list]

Thanks everyone for your feedback and continued support!

notes.title: UPDATE v1.01
notes.content:
Based on community feedback, please note the following update details:
[list]
[*] Grab and carry system has been improved. Now it is easier to grab objects and they are more stable when you carry them. 
[*] The Throw power ("F" key) has been increased. 
[*] Hints for ranks and hidden objects have been added, making it easier to unlock levels, find hidden objects and collect ranks.
[*] A number of general hints have been added. 
[*] The behaviour of the fly been improved changed, especially when hit by objects.
[*] General bug fixes.
[/list]
We hope these fixes improve your gameplay experience and thanks for your continued support.
